# NameCollector

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** NameCollector

## What it does

NameCollector is a one-shot utility that captures the names of every player currently visible in the server's tab list and writes them to a text file on your machine. The moment you enable the module, it immediately gathers all online player names, saves them to a timestamped .txt file inside the name-captures folder within LiquidBounce's config directory, and then disables itself — there is no persistent active state.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/namecollector). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
